name: @jskit-ai/auth-pass
description: One-time signed sign-in passes (Ed25519, one person, one application, one resource, about a minute): signPass for the issuer, verifyPass and its refusals for the application. It installs no providers, so an application with its own sign-in can check passes with it alone.

surfaces.summary: One-time signed passes: signPass for the issuer's server (Ed25519, one person, one audience, one resource, about 60 seconds), verifyPass for the application, resolvePassSignInFromEnv, which reads AUTH_PASS_PUBLIC_KEY, AUTH_PASS_AUDIENCE and AUTH_PASS_RESOURCE, and PASS_TEXTS with createPassError, the refusals (auth.pass.*) an application throws for a used pass or one naming nobody it knows.
